caption: The drawing depicts a top-down view of a landscaped garden surrounding a large house positioned near the center right. The house is rendered in brown and beige tones with green foliage around it. Multiple curved and straight pathways, colored in light tan, traverse the scene and border lawn areas shaded with green. Toward the top, an expansive, irregularly-shaped flowerbed is filled with patches of pink, blue, purple, and white color, and is outlined with green shrubs or small trees. Scattered throughout the garden and along the paths are deciduous trees with rounded canopies in shades of green and some flowering in pale pink. Near the upper right is a small, brown, octagonal gazebo. In the lower part of the drawing, several detailed insets are embedded into the layout, depicting garden ornaments: an elaborate gray stone urn with winged figures, a white statue of a robed woman, a more classical stone urn, and a white ornate iron bench. Additionally, a large floral bed with an oval shape, filled with pink, yellow, and red flowers, is placed to the front lawn area below the house. Shrubs, statuary, and small trees are distributed evenly throughout the property, interspersed with green grass spaces, creating a balanced garden composition.
title: William A. Wheelock Estate
